Over-refusal beyond the pins, allowed direction: secret patterns also meet option values (`--include=*.pem`, `-g '*.pem'`), redirect targets (`> server.key`) and assignment right-hand sides.
-ea stays refused by the existing own-flag walk (isEncodedName); it is only excluded from the new F1 token pass, as briefed.
scriptTarget hands a relative operand to readScript as written, and the cwd-resolved path only after a cd moved the cwd.
node: after the first positional, dash words are script arguments, not node options (so a later -e cannot suppress reading the script).
F6 is implemented as a second full scan of the text with escapes removed (sh syntax only), so a text containing a backslash outside single quotes is scanned twice per level.
wiringNotes: With every node positional read, a real readScript that returns null for non-file positionals (the --out value, the literal `node` in the capture-evidence route) will refuse; N3-1 is green only because the fake reader falls back to a benign script.
cd handling is syntactic: cd -, subshell scoping and pushd/popd stack semantics are not modelled.
